Application Data.NAME: Riverstone Beverage Distributors
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Riverstone Beverage Distributors specializes in the wholesale and retail distribution of a wide variety of alcoholic beverages, including craft beers, premium wines, and distilled spirits. Our operations encompass sourcing products from licensed local and regional breweries, wineries, and distilleries to ensure quality and compliance with all relevant regulations. We have established strong relationships with verified suppliers to guarantee the authenticity and traceability of our inventory. Our retail storefront features a curated selection of beverages, complemented by knowledgeable staff who provide exceptional customer service and product recommendations. Additionally, we offer online sales through a secure e-commerce platform, ensuring a seamless shopping experience while implementing measures to protect customer data.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, a shipment of craft beer from a supplier was lost due to a transportation accident, resulting in a loss of $10,000. The claim was settled and the amount reimbursed. On 03/10/2023, a customer filed a claim for property damage caused by a toppled display of spirits, amounting to $5,000. This claim is currently under review. Total losses to date are $15,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Sat 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM; Sun 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the perimeter, monitored central alarm system, and on-site security personnel during high traffic hours.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• New Restriction: Businesses sourcing alcoholic beverages from unlicensed or out-of-state
suppliers without proper importation permits or certificates of origin are ineligible.
This
restriction is due to the increased risk of counterfeit or adulterated products, which can lead
to product liability claims and regulatory penalties. Verification of supplier licensing and
traceability is mandatory.
Preferred Optional Coverages
• Specialized Liquor Liability Insurance: Provides coverage for claims arising from the
sale or service of alcoholic beverages, including bodily injury or property damage caused by
intoxicated patrons.
• Central Alarm System Discount: Many insurers offer premium credits for businesses
with monitored alarm systems and video surveillance protecting high-value inventory.
• Online Sales Protection: Coverage for cyber risks such as data breaches, payment fraud,
and business interruption related to online sales platforms.
